entities.summary: Andrew James Alberts is an American former professional ice hockey player who was a defenseman in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Boston Bruins, Philadelphia Flyers, Carolina Hurricanes and the Vancouver Canucks. A stay-at-home defenseman, he was known for playing a physical style of game.
